name: pinned-list-needle
body: source: the brief says to "extend `acceptance_node_edge_surface_is_transparent_and_pinned_in_help_tools_and_agents` (the pinned list) to include the new `implementation-phase-reviewer.md`". Inconsistency: that test's pinned structure is a list of `(agent-name, needle)` PAIRS (`let pinned: &[(&str, &str)]`), and adding a bare name is not expressible — the new entry needs a needle the generic reviewer prompt actually carries. Resolution: the new pin's needle is the authoring-tool vocabulary the reviewer names as NOT held — the template's "no spec/plan authoring (`apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add`)" line, which the de-repo'd generic body retains (mirroring the existing `("spec-review.md", "`apg_node`/`apg_edge`")` and `("agent-builder.md", "`apg_node`/`apg_edge`/`apg_plan_add`")` pins). The implementer chooses the exact substring; the generic template must carry that clause. Note the test's separate loop already scans EVERY embedded AGENTS entry for retired surfaces, so the new prompt is additionally covered there without a pin. [autonomous]
